The Grizzlies defeated the Kings, 123-112 tonight in Sacramento. Ty Jerome finished with a team-high 31 points along with 6 assists and 4 rebounds for the Grizzlies, while Jaylen Wells tallied 16 points, 5 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. Zach LaVine recorded 37 points, 5 assists and 3 three pointers. The Grizzlies improve their record to 3-0 with the win, while the Kings fall to 0-3 for the season.
